boundary: Read-only existing health GET and selected own application source; no vendor backend source, firmware, media, payloads, identifiers, credentials, settings changes, model jobs or restarts.
ast_method: Both deployed source and checkout parsed by the same local interpreter; cross-version AST dump hashes are not directly compared.

findings.claim: Header name x-ident belongs to the currently accepted stable AI Key connection combination.
findings.basis: Reviewed deployed _headers and _connect_once are AST-identical to the checkout; the existing adopted channel is connected and serves positive getTaskQueueInfo counts.
findings.limitations: This establishes an accepted combination, not that each individual header is necessary. The no-token reconnect does not establish x-token. The device-service profile can accept an absent negotiated WebSocket subprotocol.

findings.claim: The existing compatible connection offers ucp4 and decodes UCP4 controller requests.
findings.basis: AST-identical _connect_once plus adopted/connected state and positive receive counts.
findings.limitations: The configured device-service profile permits the controller to select no subprotocol. This is NOT evidence that ucp4 was negotiated or is mandatory.

findings.claim: The existing AI Key configuration offers sysid 0xa5f0 with the UP-AI-KEY model on its accepted controller channel.
findings.basis: Configured equality booleans, reviewed _headers and connected adopted state.
findings.limitations: Acceptance may also involve model fallback. This is an independently observed accepted configuration, not proof of a genuine AI Key hardware identifier or a uniquely required value.

findings.claim: The existing AI Port accepted connection uses the fixed 0xa5f1 interface atom.
findings.basis: Reviewed deployed _connect_loop header/route construction, websocket_101, connected/adopted state, positive hello and parameter-agreement counts.
findings.limitations: No new handshake was induced. This supports an accepted header combination, not that each field/value is necessary. The deployed connect loop enables control for an adopted device; its control-enable branch differs from the checkout, while the header/route construction was reviewed unchanged.

findings.limitations: Names/types are established for the request envelope. Other same-name fields at different local contexts are not a full schema/compatibility attestation.

findings.claim: Successful controller-origin time-sync response checks the error field.
findings.basis: AST-identical handle_message requires matching ID, integer errorCode 0, error null/empty and valid time fields before assigning clock offset; the observed clock offset is non-null.
findings.limitations: The observed value is a derived success boolean only. No response body, clock timestamp, identifier or credential is retained. This does not establish every failure variant.

findings.claim: Successful controller-origin time-sync response checks the errorCode field.
findings.basis: AST-identical handle_message requires matching ID, integer errorCode 0, error null/empty and valid time fields before assigning clock offset; the observed clock offset is non-null.
findings.limitations: The observed value is a derived success boolean only. No response body, clock timestamp, identifier or credential is retained. This does not establish every failure variant.

findings.claim: The controller answered an emulator timeSync request with the valid correlated response.
findings.basis: AST-identical _connect_once/handle_message plus observed non-null clock-offset state.
findings.limitations: This demonstrates an answered request, not a controller-origin timeSync command or manufacturer clock-accuracy guarantee.

findings.claim: The incoming recognizeKeyFrames command carries camera as a string.
findings.basis: Positive camera_shape_counts.string, positive recognizeKeyFrames count and AST-identical _record_recognize_shape.
findings.limitations: No camera identifier is retained. This proves that command context, not every callback schema.

findings.claim: Incoming RequestAI validates the required targetUri field.
findings.basis: AST-identical _command requires targetUri string, payload object and bounded integer timeoutMs before a successful result; positive result-0 counter.
findings.limitations: Cumulative since process start; not a newly induced job. Target values and task payloads are not retained. This does not establish every supported target URI.
